title: paper-scaffold: provenance-checked Typst manuscripts that are safe for AI agents to edit
description: paper-scaffold is a Typst manuscript scaffold in which every number in the prose is read by id from a declaration file written by the analysis, with a checksum, a record of the code and data behind it, and guards on what the prose assumes about it. A static gate reports stale figures, tables and builds without re-running the analysis, and checks prose rules, word limits and journal profiles. Word export goes through pandoc with native equations. An edit guard lets a wording pass drop a number but never invent one, and a set of packaged agent skills audits claims and methods against the code that computes them.
